VBO:0200040.summary: Merry and keen to work in its standard, the black American Cocker belongs to a flushing spaniel breed with a fondness for human company. The American Spaniel Club also describes Cockers as food enthusiasts. Their gundog heritage continues in field work, alongside pursuits such as agility and obedience.
VBO:0200040.shortDescription: A merry, people-loving American spaniel whose gundog heritage extends into field work, agility and obedience.

sources.title: FCI — American Cocker Spaniel standard167
sources.evidence: Entire eight-page standard personally reread. Merry, sound, equable, not timid, keen to work; gundog/companion and speed/endurance ideal. Smallest sporting spaniel, sturdy compact deep chest and developed refined rounded skull without exaggeration; broad deep muzzle about half crown, low long silky ears, dark brown ordinary eyes, arched neck/slightly sloping topline, strong straight forelimbs/angulated muscular rear/round compact paws. Medium silky flat/slightly wavy functional coat and moderate feathering, not heavy lost-body curtain. Black includes jet black and defined black-tan points; white only small chest/throat. FCI docked-tail prescription not used for new natural full tail.

sources.title: American Spaniel Club — Choosing a Cocker
sources.evidence: Entire actual substantive body read. Gentle loving people-company, Cockers described as food enthusiasts; club describes show, field work, obedience/agility and related activities. Black including black-tan distinct from ASCOB and parti-color. Medical/testing, children/pet suitability, household or training prescriptions excluded; no guarantee all Cockers perform any task. Tracking occurs only in navigation and is excluded; literal substantive body supports obedience.

VBO:0200538.summary: Affectionate, alert and playful in its breed standard, this white-patched French Bulldog belongs to a companion breed with a lively but measured manner. Its history includes Nottingham lace makers who kept small Bulldogs as lap pets, then took them across the Channel when industrial change drove them to France.
VBO:0200538.shortDescription: An affectionate, playful French companion with a white-patched coat and a history tied to Nottingham lace makers.

sources.title: French Bull Dog Club of America — Breed Standard
sources.evidence: Entire actual substantive standard read. Affectionate even disposition, active alert playful but not unduly boisterous. Heavy-boned muscular compact adult, bat ears, square head, balanced nonexaggerated structure. Natural short low straight or screwed tail, not curly. Permitted fawn/brindle/white/piebald shared coat possibilities. All suitability/medical clauses excluded from prose; no coat-specific behavior claim.

sources.title: French Bull Dog Club of America — Breed Information
sources.evidence: Entire actual body read. Companion breed; affectionate balanced active alert manner. Nottingham lace makers selected small toy Bulldogs as lap pets; industrial change displaced workers who crossed Channel taking small dogs to France; Americanclub1897. Generalcare/temperature/water/health/children/pet suitability and causal-genetic behavior excluded.

sources.title: FCI — French Bulldog standard101, current2023
sources.evidence: Entire nine-page current2023 PDF read. Sociable lively playful companion ideals. Small stocky muscular slightly-longer-than-tall body; broad square head/short broad muzzle with open black nostrils/no exaggerated shortening, natural medium rounded bat ears, dark rounded nonbulging eyes, strong short neck/gentle progressive roach/deep barrel chest/tuck, short straight forelimbs/strong longer rear/low hocks/compact round paws. Full natural SHORT low tail ideally covering anus, thick root/tapered free end, straight/kinked allowed, never above horizontal, never tailless/ingrown. Smooth short coat without undercoat. Separate FCI colouring vs white spotting: fawn or brindle with moderate/important white spotting exact0538; choose fawn-white pied, not near-solid fawn/black-white/liver/blue/merle.

VBO:0201373.summary: Intelligent, alert and companionable in its UKC standard, the Treeing Tennessee Brindle is a scent hunter with a strong instinct to tree game. Its voice marks the work: it calls along the trail, then changes its bark at the tree, where a coarse, repeated chop is preferred.
VBO:0201373.shortDescription: An alert, companionable scent hunter that trees game and changes its voice when the trail reaches the tree.

sources.title: United Kennel Club — Treeing Tennessee Brindle standard
sources.evidence: Entire actual two-page PDF read. Intelligent alert companionable fast hunter with good scenting and strong treeing instinct; open trailers, voice changeover at tree, coarse chop preferred. Origin uncertain, promoted from selected Cur-type hunting dogs, UKCrecognition2017. Powerful agile medium16–24in adult, flat wide skull/heavy muzzle/dark expressive ordinary prominent eyes, high short-medium ears, strong straight muscular limbs, straight strong back/broaddeepchest/round compact catpaws, medium full tail (stub seriousfault), short dense smooth brindle or blackwithbrindletrim coat; smallwhitechestfeet permitted. No Plottalias/genericCur substitution or empirical performance guarantees.
